thread:
Mia Chen: FYI noticed weirdness in April batch for ACME — two invoices generated. One has missing reserved-capacity line, the other has a phantom $0 credit. Customer flagged it.
Tom Alvarez: Ugh. Do you have the invoice IDs?
Mia Chen: Yep: inv_2026_0423_892 and inv_2026_0423_893. Looks like inv_892 is missing the reserved_capacity line item entirely.
Tom Alvarez: Can you dump the render log or job id?
Mia Chen: Render job id: render-2026-04-23-17-11-7. Snippet from logs:
```
INFO render start tenant=acme job=render-2026-04-23-17-11-7
WARN partial_render: missing line reserved_capacity
INFO wrote invoice inv_2026_0423_892
INFO wrote invoice inv_2026_0423_893 (with credit 0.00)
```
Invoicing Bot: invoice-renderer: job render-2026-04-23-17-11-7 completed with warnings. Duplicate output files detected for tenant acme. Retry scheduled.
Jordan Patel: Stripe shows both invoices present and one already emailed. Which one went out?
Mia Chen: inv_893 was emailed (email id msg_6782). We should stop further emails.
Anna S.: Please pause auto-send for ACME until we reconcile. Tagging billing-ops.
Tom Alvarez: Is this a race between the batching worker and the retry? Could be the job retried after partial write.
Mia Chen: Guessing hypothesis: job wrote invoice A, then got a transient DB timeout while writing line items -> retried and wrote invoice B but omitted duplicates check for reserved line merge.
Jordan Patel: Also saw a note in the export that tokenization of usage had a gap — some usage groups moved to the second invoice. That could explain the missing compute line.
Tom Alvarez: Can you attach the raw invoice JSONs? Need to diff line items and totals.
Mia Chen: Attached below (redacted):
inv_892 line_items: ["base plan", "support fee"] total=1200.00
inv_893 line_items: ["base plan", "reserved_capacity (missing)", "compute usage"] total=0.00 credit=0.00
Tom Alvarez: Wait inv_893 total=0.00? That looks like a stub created by retry code path. That explains the phantom credit.
Anna S.: Action items: 1) Pause sends for ACME, 2) Reconcile invoices and determine correct single invoice, 3) Re-run renderer with idempotency fixes, 4) Notify customer with apology + correct invoice.
Mia Chen: I'll pause sends now and queue a backfill. Mia Chen: @Tom can you take the idempotency fix ticket? Tom Alvarez: Yep — will open a PR to check for existing invoice hashes before final write.
Jordan Patel: I'll reconcile with Stripe export and create a reversal for the emailed stub if needed.
Invoicing Bot: admin: auto-send paused for tenant=acme by user=Mia Chen
Anna S.: Thanks all. Keep updates here, no external comms until we confirm the correct invoice.
Tom Alvarez: Quick note — add a metric for "partial_render_count" so we catch this earlier.
Mia Chen: Good idea. I'll add it to the renderer telemetry ticket.
Jordan Patel: I'll post final reconciliation once Stripe and DB match.
Mia Chen: Thanks — ping if you need the raw job artifacts.
